description: Carta do Plano Específico de Zona de Proteção dos Aeródromos do Rio de Janeiro/Galeão - Antônio Carlos Jobim, Santos Dumont, Jacarepaguá e Campo Délio Jardim de Mattos - RJ is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Plano Específico de Zona de Proteção de Aeródromos é um documento de aplicação específica que estabelece as restrições impostas ao aproveitamento das propriedades dentro da Zona de um determinado aeródromo, conforme Portaria 1.141/GM5, de 8 de dezembro de 1987. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Zona de Proteção de Aeródromo, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
